557:t_001:16.en:
$$カヲル$$
(You feel it too, $$シンジ$$. The same atmosphere as that place...)

557:t_001:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no problem. I'll find $$千鳥$$ and put an end to everything.」

557:t_001:19.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wherever you are, whatever the situation, I'll do it, $$千鳥$$...!)

557:t_001:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be careful, everyone. Even I don't know what $$レナード$$ has prepared.」

557:t_001:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「This world belongs to everyone who lives in it! We won't let them carry out their selfish $$時空修復$$!」

557:t_001:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, begin your attack! We'll settle things with $$アマルガム$$ here!」

557:t_002:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do they seek to transform the world, too?」

557:t_003:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Angels!? Ones we already defeated, too!」

557:t_003:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「What's going on!? Even the one that possessed Unit-03 is here!」

557:t_003:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's probably because of the space here.」

557:t_003:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Cause and effect are already jumbled here. Concepts such as before and after have no meaning.」

557:t_003:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「So they think $$セントラルドグマ$$ is here and came from the past or wherever!?」

557:t_003:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If you force a logical explanation onto it, yes.」

557:t_003:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
(And they were probably drawn here by its presence.)

557:t_003:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The Angel that hurt $$アスカ$$... And the Angel that took $$綾波$$ away...」

557:t_003:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be careful! The Angels seem to be ignoring $$アマルガム$$ and targeting only us!」

557:t_003:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Because the EVAs are on our side!」

557:t_003:15.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Who cares!? If they're coming at us, I'll take them on!」

557:t_003:17.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I know, $$シンジ$$. Dealing with them is our job.」

557:t_003:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「How pathetic. Hollow wanderers seeking new life. But I can't let you have that.」

557:t_007:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「W-what are you saying!?」

557:t_007:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「W-what are you saying!?」

557:t_007:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Are you two trying to die!?」

557:t_007:7.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If that's what $$シンジ$$ chooses.」

557:t_007:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If you can't change the past, what will you do, $$シンジ$$?」

557:t_007:11.en:
$$カヲル$$
「If you have to live suffering over what you've done, running away from it is another option.」

557:t_007:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't even think of doing something stupid, $$シンジ$$!」

557:t_007:14.en:
$$シモン$$
「I don't know what happened to you, but you're fighting with us now!」

557:t_007:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$碇シンジ$$! Even if you can't change the past, you can change the future!」

557:t_007:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you've turned your back on the past, your eyes should be facing forward!!」

557:t_007:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your father's hold over you and your fate don't matter! What are you looking at now!?」

557:t_010:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Is that $$ロンギヌス$$... or $$カシウス$$...?」

557:t_010:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Either way, the spear is in the EVA...」

557:t_010:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「What'll you do, Princess? Take it out because it's dangerous?」

557:t_010:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「But if both spears ever come together, then...」
